name: sftpgo
title: SFTPGo
description: SFTPGo is an SFTP, FTPS, WebDAV and HTTP file server with per-user folders, quotas, virtual folders and a web admin plus a web client for users. Log in to the admin UI with the credentials below and create users under App-Data/SFTPGo/data.

variables.name: SFTPGO_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.label: Admin password
variables.description: For the web admin (the first admin is created from these on first start)
